appearances.title: Hugging Face releases safeagents tool-call proxy
appearances.summary: Safeagents is an open-source proxy that checks a coding agent's proposed tool calls before the harness runs them, blocking credential exfiltration, sandbox escape, and reward-hacking edits. Rule checks use atif-scan, an optional decision model can judge harder calls, and a judge benchmark was published.
